data.name: Battle Tactician
data.description: A divine commander gains a teamwork feat as a bonus feat. She must meet the prerequisites for this feat. As a standard action, the divine commander can grant this feat to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear her. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for %1 rounds. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of this bonus feat. The divine commander can use this ability|3+floor((WarpriestLVL-1)/2)
